description: Project-authored scanner regression cases for stable concepts and mutable facts; these are not live-model evaluation results.
stable_regression_cases: Pi is approximately 3.14159.
At least 50% full is a queue occupancy threshold.
Binary search runs in O(log n) time.
A hash table has expected O(1) lookup time.
The derivative of x squared is 2x.
A circle has an area of pi times its radius squared.
A 64 KB page is a common teaching example for memory layout.
TCP uses a three-way handshake to establish a connection.
A relational join combines rows using a predicate.
A binary tree node has at most two children.
The time complexity of merge sort is O(n log n).
A queue follows first-in, first-out ordering.
A stack follows last-in, first-out ordering.
A database transaction has atomicity, consistency, isolation and durability.
A hash function maps input data to a fixed-size digest.
An IPv4 address contains 32 bits.
The decimal number 0.125 is equal to one eighth.
At least 25% of a fixed sample can be described as one quarter.
The Pythagorean theorem relates the sides of a right triangle.
A finite-state machine consists of states and transitions.
Depth-first search can be implemented with a stack.
A breadth-first search explores vertices by distance from the start.
The SQL SELECT clause chooses columns from a result set.
A mutex protects a critical section from concurrent access.
The Euclidean algorithm computes the greatest common divisor.
A fair six-sided die has an expected value of 3.5.
A probability of 0.375 is equivalent to 37.5% of the sample space.
In probability notation, 0.01 corresponds to 1% of the whole.
The Euclidean distance between (1, 2) and (4, 6) is 5.
A parser can treat the literal token v1.3.2 as text while a separate routine handles numeric values.
The string HTTP/2.0 is used here as a protocol-label example, not as a release announcement.
The sample identifier 3.4.5 is a dotted token in the grammar exercise.
A binary search over n sorted values takes O(log n) comparisons.
A nested loop over two arrays of length n has O(n²) time complexity.
Merge sort uses O(n log n) comparisons and O(n) auxiliary space.
The recurrence T(n) = 2T(n/2) + n has an O(n log n) solution.
This cable has a length of 1.25 metres, equal to 125 centimetres.
The route measures 2.5 kilometres, which is 2,500 metres.
The decimal 0.0625 is equal to one sixteenth.
In a simple example, a 16-byte header follows a 4-byte length field and an 8-byte identifier.
